path: Linux VM on local LAN -> public EC2 server -> Windows agent -> HTTP server on Windows vEthernet; no packet shaper

server.tls: ephemeral self-signed certificate, client/agent skip CA verification and pin SHA-256 fingerprint f4b9783ee28f46e1fae4067c3caf4dc6e7a15379add7faf369dbf2e8eed5412e

methodology: Three sequential repeats per carrier; each helper request checks exact byte count and SHA-256; competing workload starts ten 1 MiB transfers, waits 0.5 seconds, then starts ten 64-byte requests; results are aggregate application payload throughput
